jobs.name: khan_assault_lead
jobs.prompt: Use case: background-extraction and precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a three-man futuristic breaching squad. Image 2 is a COSTUME REFERENCE ONLY, the user's existing Khan infantry game model. Make one high-detail realistic painted concept-art cutout of the specified soldier from image 1, extended to FULL BODY head to both boot soles. Preserve his specific upper-body lean, orientation and action from image 1, reconstruct occluded anatomy and legs in a believable balanced combat stance. Adapt clothing to Khan infantry from image 2: near-black charcoal blue-green field uniform, burgundy-red collar/short neck wrap, charcoal segmented chest armour with three horizontal plates, brown leather straps and ammunition pouches, restrained small brass fittings, dark field cap with burgundy band and tiny plain brass diamond badge, tall worn brown leather boots. Keep gritty painterly realism and quality of image 1, NOT the low-poly rendering of image 2. Remove exposed sci-fi exoskeleton mechanisms, robotic armour, full futuristic visor and yellow numbers. Real human military infantry, realistic utilitarian assault rifle, no invented national flags, no modern Russian patches, no extra symbols. Each hand has anatomically correct fingers gripping the gun, no fused fingers and gun parts. Entire person and entire weapon inside canvas, modest transparent margin above cap and below both boots. ONE soldier only on actual transparent alpha background. No environment, no floor, no fire, no smoke, no cast ground shadow, no captions or checkerboard. Clear silhouette, detailed cloth and metal, subtle warm edge light from original source. SUBJECT: the closest foreground soldier in image 1, originally helmet marked 50. Retain lowered head turned toward screen-right and forward-hunched shoulders, rifle held diagonally downward across chest with both hands. A tense advancing crouch, knees bent and boots apart. Adapt to the field cap reference, human face partly in shadow.
